# Lonely Planet

> > The world's leading travel media company providing guidebooks, digital content, and custom travel booking services for destinations worldwide.

Lonely Planet offers comprehensive travel guides covering every continent, from country-specific guidebooks to curated collections like Best in Travel 2026 and 100 Weekends in Europe. The platform combines traditional guidebooks with digital resources and personalized trip planning through Lonely Planet Journeys.

## Key Topics

- Travel guidebooks
- Destination guides
- Travel inspiration
- Lonely Planet Journeys
- Best in Travel 2026
- Europe travel
- Asia travel
- Country guides
- Multi-country guides
- Travel itineraries
- Ebooks and maps
- Weekend trips
- Custom travel booking
- National parks
- Cultural experiences

## Homepage & Core Services

- [Travel Guides & Travel Inspiration - Lonely Planet](https://auth.lonelyplanet.com/): Homepage with travel guides and inspiration for destinations like Japan
- [Lonely Planet Journeys - Lonely Planet](https://www.lonelyplanet.com/journeys): Custom travel booking service with ready-made and personalized itineraries
- [Lonely Planet Travel Guidebooks: Free Shipping & Immediate Delivery](https://shop.lonelyplanet.com/): Main shop homepage for guidebooks, maps, and travel products with shipping

## Featured Collections & Annual Guides

- [Lonely Planet's Best in Travel 2026 - Book](https://shop.lonelyplanet.com/products/lonely-planets-best-in-travel-2026): Annual bestseller featuring 25 top destinations and experiences for 2026
- [The World - Book](https://shop.lonelyplanet.com/products/the-world): Global reference guide covering every country with top experiences
- [100 Weekends in Europe](https://shop.lonelyplanet.com/products/100-weekends-in-europe): European weekend trip guide with 100 mapped itineraries across Europe

## Regional Destination Hubs

- [Asia](https://www.lonelyplanet.com/destinations/asia): Asia destination hub covering Japan, Kazakhstan, Hanoi & regional highlights
- [Australia Travel Guides | Lonely Planet](https://shop.lonelyplanet.com/collections/australia): Australia guide collection covering Sydney, Great Barrier Reef & Brisbane

## Country & Regional Guidebooks

- [USA Travel Book and Ebook](https://shop.lonelyplanet.com/products/usa?variant=44323489710331): Comprehensive USA guidebook with national parks and city itineraries
- [Greece Travel Book and Ebook](https://shop.lonelyplanet.com/products/greece): Greece guidebook featuring Greek Islands, Athens, Crete & Tinos villages
- [India Travel Guide](https://shop.lonelyplanet.com/products/india): India guidebook covering Kerala, Rajasthan, and South India highlights
- [Korea Travel Guide](https://shop.lonelyplanet.com/products/korea): Korea travel guide featuring Jeju-do, Changdeokgung palace & festivals
- [Eastern Europe Travel Book and Ebook](https://shop.lonelyplanet.com/products/eastern-europe?variant=44334068105467): Guidebook covering Dubrovnik, Krakow, Moscow & Eastern Europe destinations
